comments.comment: Thank you for helping this mom and your heart for the unborn. 💕

Praying for mom and baby!!! Thank you for putting this together girl 💖 I know that you, technology and accounting don’t always get along great (in your defense, legalese is one heck of a language). Rooting for you, for mom, and for baby S! 💖🙏
You can do this! Your child is the size of a strawberry and his or her heart is already beating. Rooting for you ❤️

My prayer now is that you will receive all the strength that God can give you and feel his grace come over you as you walk your new path, with him right by your side. Don’t listen to anyone who tries to convince you otherwise, you’ve made the right decision to keep that little child and protect him. I will be happy to help you move forward.
